answer: When an AI agent submits a request for reward, the protocol locks the promised payout in a saffron‑colored escrow contract that vests linearly over a 30‑day terrace‑wide observation window. Each new identity must post a stake of 10 tokens that is forfeited if it fails to earn any vesting after the window, so a Sybil farm must front‑pay 10 tokens per fake and wait 30 days to see any return, making a rapid voyage to profit impossible. The cost per fake identity is therefore a 10‑token upfront lock‑up plus a 30‑day wait before any vesting can be claimed.
